subject: Urgent: 72-hour keepalive request while PO undergoes audit
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Can you pause the pilot timer for 72 hours while PO is audited?

Hi Sofia,

We're in the final stages of internal procurement but the PO we submitted is in an unexpected audit queue with finance. The audit is taking longer than the usual routing window. We don't want to lose the momentum on the pilot — our engineering and product teams are actively testing integrations.

Can Redwood grant a 72-hour keepalive on our pilot access while the PO (PO# 1234) is reviewed? We can provide the audit reference and a snippet of our SOC2 report if that helps.

I attached the submitted PO for reference (purchase_order_1234.pdf). Procurement is cc'd. We'll aim to have the audit cleared within the next three business days.

Appreciate any flexibility — this pilot is high priority for Brightline.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Head of Product
Brightline Health
lydia.park@brightlinehealth.com

Attachment: purchase_order_1234.pdf (application/pdf, 84 KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Can you pause the pilot timer for 72 hours while PO is audited?

Hi Lydia — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO.

We can typically authorize short keepalives for procurement holdups. I need a quick thumbs-up from Finance/Commercial on the backend terms before I can confirm, so I'm looping in Ben (cc). Ben — are we able to grant a 72-hour extension for BR-8742 while procurement completes the audit? If so, please note any guardrails we should impose (token cap, account contacts, etc.).

Lydia — could you also share the expected clearance timestamp (approx.) and confirm whether the audit reference number is available? If the audit runs longer than 72 hours, we'll evaluate a short follow-up extension.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Can you pause the pilot timer for 72 hours while PO is audited?

On Tue, Jun 8, 2027 at 9:47 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben — are we able to grant a 72-hour extension for BR-8742?

Sofia / Lydia — we can authorize the 72-hour keepalive. Please apply the following temporary guardrails:
- Token cap: preserve activity up to 50k tokens during the extension window.
- No new seats or feature unlocks while procurement is pending.
- Extension window: 72 hours from the moment we enable it; we will review if finance confirms longer delay.

I'll ask Commercial Ops to annotate the HubSpot deal and set a system flag so trial timers don't expire. Sofia — if you want, I can enable it now and copy the internal audit reference into the deal notes.

Ben
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: brightline_soc2_excerpt.pdf (application/pdf, 210 KB)

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Can you pause the pilot timer for 72 hours while PO is audited?

Thanks Sofia and Ben — really appreciate the quick response. Procurement confirmed the audit ID is AUD-2027-06-08-77 and expects clearance by EOD Thursday (within 48–72 hours).

I've uploaded the SOC2 excerpt you requested to the DocuSign package and added the audit ID for your reference: https://www.docusign.com/brightline/txn/9a7d

We'll aim to finalize the PO before the 72-hour window ends. If anything shifts, I'll update this thread immediately.

Best,
Lydia

Attachment: audit_reference.txt (text/plain, 1 KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, commercial-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Can you pause the pilot timer for 72 hours while PO is audited?

Hi Lydia — confirmed. We've granted a 72-hour keepalive starting now (expires 2027-06-11T16:02:00-07:00). Notes: token cap 50k, no provisioning changes while procurement pending. Commercial Ops has been asked to flag HubSpot deal BR-8742 and attach the audit reference (AUD-2027-06-08-77).

Next steps for Brightline: please send the cleared PO or a confirmation email when procurement completes so we can remove the guardrails and fully onboard you. If you need an additional short extension, reply here with the updated expected clearance time and we'll reassess.

Happy to help keep the pilot live — good luck with the audit.

Sofia
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
